_about: IMG34 (wsqyn): each arm's food(s), as set_item (the study's 52 sets x 10 items) and the Restrain database's FoodID (VSM stim order.csv). An arm is one (heading, image file), so one food spans up to three arms (its A, B and C pages, headings and re-encoded copies differing) and one arm can serve two foods (Hamburger, sets 46 and 47). A held-out image split must group by food_id or set_item, never by condition_num alone. Written by scripts/gen_wsqyn.py.
